title: Updates
subtitle: Icosa checks GitHub for a newer Windows installer. Your dictionary and settings stay in AppData.
upToDate: You are on the latest version.
idle: Icosa checks for updates on startup and every few hours.
backingUp: Backing up your dictionary and settings…
unsupportedDev: Auto-update runs in the installed Windows app, not in development.
unsupportedPortable: Auto-update is available in the Windows installer. The portable build keeps your data but does not self-update.
unsupportedPlatform: Auto-update is only published for the Windows installer.
updatedFrom: Icosa was updated from v{{from}} to v{{to}}.

errors.checkFailed: Could not check for updates. Try again later.
errors.downloadFailed: The update download failed. Try again.
errors.backupFailed: Could not back up your data. The update was not installed.
errors.installFailed: The update could not be installed. Try again.
errors.untrusted: The update file was rejected because it is not the Icosa Windows installer.
errors.offline: You are offline. Icosa will check again later.
errors.unsupported: This copy of Icosa cannot auto-update.
